name: social-flow
description: Channel-based video pipeline: storyboard plans and stops for approval, produce builds an approved episode, and autoproduce runs the same checks unattended. Each cut chooses a still with camera movement, an acted 3D character scene, a 3D object explanation, a source-based chart, essential generated video, or a limited quote/verdict slide. Repeated render reasons and text-led episodes fail before assets. Charts use a shared deterministic SVG renderer with honest scales and narrated focus beats. Production verifies the source plan, slide files, segment narration and rendered clip hashes before assembly, then checks opening and delivery timing. Research and narration reviews ground the story in evidence. Publishing to Threads, Instagram, Facebook and YouTube follows approval; optional credentials enable platform growth workflows. The bundled MCP server provides media, research and publishing tools without an external MCP dependency.
